video_summary.overall_sceneDescription: An animated scene featuring characters from Peppa Pig indoors, where they are playing a game of pretending to have babies using cushions, leading to loud crying and a humorous conclusion.
video_summary.main_content_summary: Peppa talks about pretending to have a baby, switches roles with another character, starts crying loudly, is joined by Grandfather Pig and Mummy Pig in crying, watches it on TV, and ultimately decides to keep her cushion instead of a real baby because real babies are too noisy.

audio_events.detailed_description: Peppa speaks the dialogue: 'I was pretending I had a baby in my tummy, but now we can pretend that you're my baby.'
audio_events.observation: Spoken English dialogue by Peppa Pig

audio_events.detailed_description: A loud, exaggerated crying and screaming sound ("Waaah!") emitted by the character.
Multiple characters crying and wailing loudly together.
Peppa speaks the dialogue: 'Real babies are quite noisy, actually.'
audio_events.observation: Spoken English dialogue by Peppa Pig

audio_events.detailed_description: Peppa speaks the dialogue: 'So I think I'll keep my cushion instead.'
audio_events.observation: Spoken English dialogue by Peppa Pig
